thread:
maria: Heads-up — UX asks us to surface per-route SLO thresholds and a compact notify toggle in the Console. They want a single-pane view where you can see the effective SLO after routing rules/quota overrides.
kevin: Are we talking just display, or should Console enforce fallback routing when a tier hits its quota?
sara: Ideally display-only for v1. Enforcement at routing-level adds surprise for tenants. We still need a clear ‘what changed’ diff when effective SLO differs from configured SLO.
maria: Right. Product wants an actionable card: if effective error budget < X then show suggested canary rollback. Not a hardkill, just a CTA.
irene: From infra side — we already compute per-tenant burn rates in ingest. Adding a realtime effective-SLO calc isn't heavy if we reuse the existing projection service, but we need contract on how many decimal places and bucketing.
kevin: Question: where do we keep the canonical policy? Two options: 1) Console computes effective SLO client-side from raw rules fetched from the Policy API, or 2) Policy API exposes an /effective-slo endpoint that returns precomputed result for a given route+tenant.
maria: Console team prefers option 1 for low-latency UI interactions and to show diffs, but option 2 makes telemetry consistent and avoids duplicated logic.
sara: Telemetry ops: if Console computes, we'll get telemetry skew (two sources publishing slightly different numbers). That hurts alerting and long-term audits.
kevin: Also an implementation note: if Console computes, we'll need to pull in the full routing graph (policy precedence, quiet windows, quota overrides). That's a bigger payload.
irene: Proposal: Policy API implements /effective-slo?explain=true which returns a small object: {effective_slo, reasons[]} — we can then render diffs and CTA. It also increments a compute-meter so we can quota UI calls.
maria: Love the explain=true idea. Can we get a compact explain we can show inline and a link to a verbose explain page?
\ksara (typo?) -- oops, ignore.
sara: +1 to explain=true. One more ask: include the time-window used for burn-rate calc (e.g., 1h/6h/24h). Console needs to display which window drives the recommendation.
kevin: For rollout UX: when effective SLO deviation triggered, Console wants a canary rollout button that calls the internal rollout API with a stage=canary param. We should gate that behind RBAC.
irene: Rollout API already supports stage param. We'll add an audit event on action. Deploy-bot: "rollout: canary start requested by maria for route /generate (id: route-73)"
maria: Sample UI edge case: tenant has a soft-quota (monthly token cap) and SLO looks fine, but projected spend will blow the quota. We should surface both error-budget and cost-projection side-by-side.
sara: That needs a new telemetry join: burn-rate + spend-projection. We have projections service but not joined at the Policy API. Could be added as optional fields in /effective-slo?include_spend=true.
kevin: API contract sketch (pseudo):
```json
GET /effective-slo?route=route-73&tenant=tid-9&explain=true&include_spend=true
{
  "effective_slo": "99.8%",
  "window": "6h",
  "burn_rate": 1.8,
  "spend_projection": "$420/month",
  "reasons": ["per-tenant quiet-window override","fallback-model: small-latency-variant"]
}
```
kevin: Note: keep fields stable — strings for human text, numeric strings if needed to avoid schema churn.
irene: Perf caveat: include_spend=true should be cached for ~60s because spend projections hit billing data.
maria: UX nit: show a small red/yellow/green pill for effective SLO health and a tooltip that lists the top 2 contributing factors.
sara: For alerts surfaced via Console: ops wants a chooseable notify chain. We need a mapping UI: SLO-violation -> notify-policy (pager/escalation/ops-channel). The tricky bit is dedup when multiple routes share a tenant.
kevin: Dedup idea: fingerprint alerts by (tenant, root-cause) where root-cause is the highest-weighted signal from the explain payload. Then Console will group threads automatically.
irene: Sounds good. We also need an API change: expose fingerprint key in the explain output.
maria: Security: RBAC check before exposing tenant-level spend and effective SLO. Some roles can only see service-level SLOs (not tenant).
sara: We'll need a privacy flag in Policy API: tenant_private=true -> requires scope=tenant:read. If missing, API returns 403.
kevin: Implementation plan:
- Policy API: add /effective-slo with explain, include_spend, fingerprint (2 wks).
- Console: render compact card + verbose explain link + canary CTA + RBAC checks (1 sprint).
- Telemetry: add explain.result emitted to tracing with sampling 1% (ops) and full for manual requests (2 wks).
- Docs: update SLO/notify mapping guide + UI screenshots.
irene: Also add a rate limit for explain calls from Console and a circuit-breaker to avoid cascading compute on heavy dashboards.
maria: Approval? Anyone blocking?
sara: No blockers from SRE, but we need QA on dedup logic.
kevin: I'll open a PR with API stubs and unit tests.
maria: Great — assign to @kevin and @irene, product will follow up on copy. Thanks all :tada:
deploy-bot: "deployer: stubbed /effective-slo endpoint pushed to staging by kevin (build 4821)."
kevin: staging endpoint is live at https://staging.policy.internal/effective-slo?route=route-73&tenant=tid-9
maria: I'll sync with UX on the pill colors and tooltip text tomorrow.
sara: Filing a QA checklist now: dedup, RBAC, explain accuracy, spend join, telemetry sampling.
kevin: PR: https://git.internal/repo/policy-api/pulls/89 — feedback welcome.
